= Introduction =

Here you can find how to install Robinviz.

= Runtime Requirements =
 * Python 2.6
 * PyQt 4.7

= Library Requirements =
 * LEDA 5.1+ Library from Algorithmic Solutions

= Linux =
== Binary ==
 # Use the following command to install PyQt4:
{{{
sudo apt-get install python-qt4
}}}

 # Run the installer file: Robinviz-1.0-beta-Linux-x86-Install. If it doesn't run by clicking, use the following command to give it executable rights and run it:
{{{
chmod +x Robinviz-1.0-beta-Linux-x86-Install
./Robinviz-1.0-beta-Linux-x86-Install
}}}
 # After the installation, open a new terminal/konsole to run the program with updated PATH variables. Move into the installation dir and run robinviz.exe
{{{
cd ~/robinviz
./robinviz.exe
}}}

== Source ==
 # Use the following command to install the required packages:
{{{
sudo apt-get install python-qt4 g++ libX11-dev
}}}
 # Copy the distribution folder to anywhere you like (for example inside your home dir)
{{{
cp robinviz-1.0-beta-linux-source ~/robinviz
}}}
 # Add the following lines to your ~/.bashrc (Make sure that incl folder is inside this LEDA_ROOT):
{{{
export LEDAROOT=/path/to/LEDA
export PATH=$PATH:$LEDAROOT/Manual/cmd
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$LD_LIBRARY_PATH:$LEDAROOT
}}}
 # Give the following command on console: 
{{{
source ~/.bashrc
}}}
 # Move to the robinviz directory on console and give the following command:
{{{
cd ~/robinviz
sh compile.sh
./robinviz.exe
}}}

= Windows =

==Requirements==
 * Windows XP SP3 / Vista (recommended)
 * Visual Studio 2005 C++ or over
 * [http://www.python.org/download/ Python 2.7] and [http://www.riverbankcomputing.co.uk/software/pyqt/download PyQt 4.7+]. If you are using Windows XP, you may need to add python to your [http://showmedo.com/videotutorials/video?name=960000&fromSeriesID=96 system path]. 

==Binary==
 # Start the installation wizard to install the program under C:\Robinviz
 # Double click on the Robinviz icon on your desktop.

==Source==

 # Follow the instructions at http://www.algorithmicsolutions.info/leda_manual/DLL_s_MS_Visual.html

or

 # Use sample Visual Studio 2005 Solution Template located at the main source distribution folder.
 # Setup LEDA 5.1+ Library from Algorithmic Solutions
 # Follow the instructions at http://www.algorithmic-solutions.info/leda_manual/DLL_s_MS_Visual.html or if you use the template, you will need to add library path and include folder from menu bar Tools->Options->Project and Solutions->VC++ Directories.
